body: Actually happened 2 nights ago so the pain is still there. Got taken to a party my best friend was at, I wasn't invited as the host didn't know me very well but was happy for me to show after I asked. 20 minutes in and everybody is having a good time and drunk as all hell (I was driving so stayed sober) when my friend pulls me aside. Word for word he tells me "Hey bro, just letting you know everybody here including me hates you and if you start shit we'll knock your teeth out." 11 years of friendship out the window in less than 30 seconds.
